## Sydney Radar

The Sydney Radar Dataset (from ...) is a good example of a spatially invariant kernel IDEM (where flow is consistant across space).

The example is explored [here](./Sydney_Radar.html).

# Other

## Non-IDEM filtering

While the filters in `jaxidem` are built for filtering IDEMs, we can use the filtering techniques for general Dynamic Linear Models.
A simple tracking example is given [here](./filtering_and_smoothing.html)
